<!-- pr-reviewer: eb37242e70a7ed74dac8834e89c86fc6afff44d6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This PR changes only `#[cfg(test)]` code and comments in `crates/app/src/operation/hole_digest.rs`, and adds one decision file. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. It does not change `crates/ui`, so no screenshots are necessary.

### What looks good
- The new pins change each of the ten `CrossHole` fields by one lattice step (1e-6 mm). They check that both `hole_digest::cross` and `OpParams::Drill::stamp_with` move. This is what #1625 "Done means" asks for.
- The second pin checks three more things: an off-lattice `floor_d` stamps the same as its reloaded `-3.81`, noise below half a step does not move the stamp on snapped fields, and `dir` stays verbatim (as `CrossHoleDto` stores it).
- The lattice wording is correct. `cl::lattice` is `round(v * 1e6) / 1e6` in mm, so one step is 1 nm.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1625-cross-hole-digest-pin.md` has the correct format. The PR does not edit `RECOMMENDED.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`, and has no golden or snapshot changes.
- The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #1625`. The commit subject is conventional.

### Results, merged with main (locally, macOS)
Trial merge of `eb37242e` with `upstream/main` `14aa3abd`: clean, no conflicts.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` | maps `app::operation::hole_digest` to `app lib`, `app:bore_core`, `app:bore_entry` |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 305 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test bore_core` | 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test bore_entry` | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The other suites in the dry-run plan come from main's side of the merge, not from this PR. I did not run them.

### Mutations (made by the reviewer, on `hole_digest::cross`)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove `put(h, c.origin.z)` (not in the PR's list) | red: `cross_hole_stamp_moves_on_every_field` ("cross digest did not move for origin.z") |
| Snap `dir` through `put` instead of verbatim bits | red: `cross_hole_off_lattice_floor_stamps_like_reloaded_and_dir_is_verbatim` ("sub-lattice change on dir.x failed to move the stamp") |
| Hash `radius`/`entry_d`/`floor_d` verbatim (no lattice snap) | red: `cross_hole_off_lattice_floor_stamps_like_reloaded_and_dir_is_verbatim` (off-lattice `floor_d` stamp differs) |

After each mutation, I restored the file. All three pins are green again.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs:60`: the `lattice` doc comment still says "(microns)". The PR says this is out of scope. A small P7 follow-up can correct it.
2. The new test lines in `hole_digest.rs` (the `variants`, `snapped` and `verbatim` arrays) are longer than 100 characters. The project does not run `rustfmt`, so this is only a style note.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
